name: split sprinter high lunge
description: A high lunge with the arms driving like a sprinter's. It builds leg strength, balance and hip stability.
instructions: Stand tall and step one foot well back into a staggered stance.
Bend both knees and lower into a lunge, back heel lifted.
Swing the arm opposite the front leg forward and the other arm back, like sprinting.
Keep your torso upright and the front knee over the ankle.
Push through the front foot to rise, then repeat all reps.
Switch legs and do the same number.
